additional_info.subject: 0457157 - ID0457157-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP / T4 170004625] Charging Issue CRM:00472000431
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes,
Thank you for reaching out regarding the charger's performance. To ensure we fully understand your concerns and can provide the most effective support, could you please provide a more detailed description of the specific issues you've observed with this charger?
Upon reviewing the charger logs from the past week, our analysis indicates that the unit is operating within expected parameters. It's important to clarify that the presence of 0kW charging sessions in the logs does not necessarily indicate a malfunction of the charger itself.
Allow me to explain a common scenario that results in 0kW sessions:
Session Initiation:
If a user inserts the charging plug and then removes it within a very short timeframe (e.g., two seconds), the SECC will initiate a charging session. This occurs because the SECC detects a change in the Proximity Pilot (PP) signal as soon as the plug is inserted.
Session Termination:
Such a session will subsequently be recorded as 0kW. The SECC requires a brief period to properly terminate a session, especially when an unexpected user action, such as repeated insertion and removal of the plug before the vehicle is ready to charge, occurs. These instances are typically attributable to user interaction rather than a fault within the charger's hardware or software
To assist us in further investigation, could you please provide specific examples of what you perceive as incorrect charger behavior? This would ideally include details such as:
Specific dates and times of observed issues.
Any error messages displayed on the charger or vehicle.
The exact sequence of events leading to the perceived fault.
User observations at the time of the incident.
Without further specific evidence of a charger malfunction, and based on our current log analysis, we would propose closing this ticket as there are no immediate actionable items on our end.
Thank you for your cooperation.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: 0457157 - ID0457157-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP / T4 170004625] Charging Issue CRM:00472000431
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes,
The locking from the car is only done on Pilot State C. After connecting it goes to Authentication and Parameter Discovery, only when it pass to Cable Check the EV lock the plug.
There is no correlation between "No PLC Link" and fault on the charger unless it's a permanent event. In this case the charger is performing well.
See the results from last week:
I don't see the need to investigate more on this case, if you agree I will proceed to close this ticket.
